meta_description: Ryan Electrical Services Bristol. NICEIC-approved electrician offering domestic rewires, fault finding, and emergency repairs across Bristol. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault or broken socket in Bristol? We arrive same day, diagnose the problem, and fix it right.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle all domestic and small commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Trip switches, blown circuits, dead sockets — we diagnose faults fast and fix them same day. Available 24/7 for genuine emergencies.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We install modern, safe cabling throughout, with rewiring certificates for insurance and resale.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boxes with modern RCD-protected consumer units. Safer, compliant, and protects your appliances from damage.

services.title: Testing & Electrical Certificates
services.desc: Landlord certificates (EICR) and new installation testing for property sales, mortgages, and peace of mind. Fully compliant reports.

services.title: Fault Finding & Problem Solving
services.desc: Intermittent trips, flickering lights, or mystery electrical issues? We trace the root cause and fix it properly, not just the symptom.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, light switches, and outlets installed safely in walls or surface-mounted. We route cables neatly and finish to a high standard.

about_pullquote: I started because I was tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Ryan Electrical Services has been serving Bristol for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that honest work and fair pricing should go hand in hand, we've built a solid reputation fixing electrical problems for homeowners, landlords, and small businesses across the city. We're NICEIC approved and all our work carries a guarantee.
about_para_2: We don't rush jobs or cut corners. Every customer gets a proper diagnosis, a clear explanation of what needs doing, and a fixed price before we start. That's why so many people in Bristol call us back — and recommend us to their neighbours.

reviews.text: Called Ryan at 11pm on a Saturday because our kitchen had no power. He was with us by midnight and had it sorted in 20 minutes — turned out a dodgy socket had blown the circuit. Charged us less than the estimate. Absolute legend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a full rewire done while we were getting the house ready to sell. Very thorough, tidy work, and he left us with all the certificates we needed. The new owners were impressed. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Ryan diagnosed a fault our other electrician missed — flickering lights in the upstairs that were driving us mad. Proper diagnosis, fair price, fixed it properly. Recommended him to three friends already. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David C.
